title: Soirée
tagline: Elevate Your Events – Seamlessly Managed, Unforgettable Experiences Await!

prizes.title: Best use of Account Abstraction and Base Paymaster

description:
Sioree, the revolutionary event management platform, is the answer to your seamless event organization needs, whether in person or virtual. Say goodbye to the chaos of coordinating meetings with our integrated solution.

Struggling to connect attendees? Enter Push NFT Gated Group Chat – a game-changer! Sioree's innovative approach allows event-goers to engage and network effortlessly within exclusive groups, enhancing the overall experience.

Ever missed a crucial event update? Not anymore! Our Push Notifications feature ensures attendees stay informed in real-time, guaranteeing they never miss a moment.

Concerned about security and verification? Sioree implements Anon Aadhar for identity confirmation, prioritizing privacy while verifying nationality.

And the hassle of traditional ticketing? Sioree introduces NFTs as tickets on Base Blockchain, featuring Paymaster for gasless transactions. Say goodbye to transaction frustrations, and hello to a streamlined, secure ticketing process.

Sioree transforms event management into a seamless, secure, and unforgettable experience, leaving you free to focus on what truly matters – creating memorable events

how_its_made:
In the development journey of my Next.js application, I encountered a significant challenge with the integration of the Push UIWeb component, a critical element for enabling seamless chat functionality. The complexity of this component presented several issues, consuming a substantial amount of time and resources.

Undeterred by the challenges, I remained committed to delivering a polished and efficient solution. Through meticulous problem-solving and dedication, I successfully overcame the hurdles associated with the Push UIWeb component, ultimately integrating it seamlessly into my application.
